title: Bank earnings to shed the first light on how higher yields are affecting the economy
summary: Major U.S. banks report earnings this week, offering the first indicators of economic health in a rising-yield environment. These results will provide insights into how higher interest rates are affecting lending and the broader economy.
content: The big banks kick off earnings season on Tuesday, to provide a first read on the health of the economy in a rising-yield environment.

zh.title: 银行业绩首次照亮更高收益如何影响经济

title: Trump says he is 'going to look at' joining Saudi Arabia in the fight against Iran-backed Houthis after deadly airport strike
summary: Trump indicated willingness to involve U.S. military forces alongside Saudi Arabia against Iran-backed Houthis following an airport strike. Analysts caution that such involvement would further strain Middle East resources already committed to Iran operations.
content: U.S. military involvement in the fight against the Houthis would stretch resources in the Middle East already committed to fighting Iran, analysts said.

title: JPMorgan Chase, Goldman and other big banks report earnings this week. What to expect

summary: Ukraine's leadership rejected Trump's proposal for new presidential leadership while proposing a ceasefire on strikes against Russian refineries if Russia halts attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

title: DOJ says it's investigating whether White House TV pool's coverage halt violated antitrust law

content: The probe came after the TV pool of broadcasters ceased coverage after the administration barred CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.
